lines: Romantic — my antenna for love
got swept off somewhere in the storm
It can't be true — you treated me so coldly
That sly little dimple made my heart sway, just a bit
The truth is,
you're the one who matters, the one who scolds me for real
But if I said that, he'd get so smug
so I won't praise him anymore
I'm sick and tired of this dull fate
Set me free with words I've never heard — please
Darling, darling, break down the door to my heart
Say what matters most while you look into my eyes
With you, I could slip away from this town
Take me away, right now
My sweet, sweet darling
Dramatic — the secret behind that smile
is something everyone keeps searching for
I look up and trace it in the sky — the shape of happiness
Yes, I want to stay true to myself
With my capricious moods
I'll toss you around
but never let go of this hand — promise
Darling, darling, knock on the door to my heart
My honest feelings come spilling out
With you, I can keep on smiling
I'll start running, right now
My sweet, sweet darling
Darling, darling, I know I can grasp it
I'm coming to see what happiness means
With you, I can change tomorrow
Take me away, right now
My sweet, sweet darling
Darling, darling, break down the door to my heart
Say what matters most while you look into my eyes
With you, I could slip away from this town
Take me away, right now
My sweet, sweet darling
